# BusCalcTools

> 18 free business calculators and 25 long-form guides for small business owners and freelancers across the US, UK, and South Africa. Region-aware (currency, tax rates) and no sign-up required.

## About

- [About BusCalcTools](https://buscalctools.com/about): Who builds the site, editorial policy, methodology, and contact.
- [Disclaimer](https://buscalctools.com/disclaimer): Not financial advice. Educational tools only.
- [Privacy Policy](https://buscalctools.com/privacy): Calculations run in browser; no personal data transmitted.

## Topic hubs

- [Profit & Pricing](https://buscalctools.com/topics/profit-and-pricing): Calculators and guides for profit margin, markup, pricing, net profit, and ecommerce profitability.
- [Break-Even & Cash Flow](https://buscalctools.com/topics/break-even-and-cash-flow): Break-even, cost-per-unit, cash flow, burn rate, invoicing.
- [Freelance & Hiring](https://buscalctools.com/topics/freelance-and-hiring): Freelance rate, true employee cost, hire-vs-contractor.
- [Funding & Valuation](https://buscalctools.com/topics/funding-and-valuation): ROI, business loans, payback period, business valuation, revenue growth.

## Calculators — Profit & Pricing

- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/profit-margin-calculator): Gross, operating, and net margin. Region-aware corporate tax (US 21%, UK 25%, SA 27%).
- [Markup Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/markup-calculator): Convert cost to selling price at any markup, with reverse mode. Shows equivalent margin.
- [Pricing Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/pricing-calculator): Set selling price from cost + target margin or markup. Auto VAT/sales tax by region.
- [Net Profit Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/net-profit-calculator): Full revenue-to-net-profit waterfall (COGS → OpEx → interest → tax).
- [Ecommerce Profit Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/ecommerce-profit-calculator): Profit per unit after Amazon FBA, Etsy, eBay, Shopify fees + ads + VAT.
- [Discount Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/discount-calculator): Sale price, savings, percentage off, bulk savings table.

## Calculators — Break-Even & Cash Flow

- [Break-Even Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/break-even-calculator): Units and revenue needed to cover all costs, with chart and target-profit mode.
- [Cost Per Unit Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/cost-per-unit-calculator): Fixed + variable CPU with volume scaling table.
- [Cash Flow Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/cash-flow-calculator): 12-month projection with running balance chart.
- [Burn Rate Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/burn-rate-calculator): Gross burn, net burn, runway months, cash exhaustion date.
- [Invoice Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/invoice-calculator): Build totals with VAT, GST, or sales tax. Up to 5 line items.

## Calculators — Freelance & Hiring

- [Freelance Rate Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/freelance-rate-calculator): Sustainable hourly + day rate from income goal and overhead.
- [Employee Cost Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/employee-cost-calculator): True cost of a hire (salary + employer tax + benefits + equipment + office).

## Calculators — Funding & Valuation

- [ROI Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/roi-calculator): Total and annualised ROI for any business investment.
- [Business Loan Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/business-loan-calculator): Monthly payment + amortisation schedule. Region-aware APR pre-fill.
- [Payback Period Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/payback-period-calculator): Simple + discounted payback period.
- [Business Valuation Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/business-valuation-calculator): Revenue multiple, EBITDA multiple, 5-year DCF side-by-side.
- [Revenue Growth Calculator](https://buscalctools.com/revenue-growth-calculator): MoM, YoY, and CAGR.

## Methodology

- All tax rate defaults are sourced from primary government data (IRS, GOV.UK/HMRC, SARS) and reviewed annually. Each calculator page lists its sources with last-verified dates.
- Calculations run entirely in the browser; no personal data is transmitted.
- Articles are originally authored by James Blanckenberg and fact-checked against primary sources.
